newsitem.title: USA: Brylane sees Q2 EPS above estimate.
newsitem.headline: Brylane sees Q2 EPS above estimate.

text.p: Brylane Inc said Thursday it expects fully diluted earnings per share of about $0.47 for the second quarter ending August 2, compared to pro forma earnings in the year-ago period of $0.28.
According to First Call, the consensus estimate for Brylane's second quarter is $0.40 a share.
Brylane said sales, which are trending ahead of expectations, have benefitted from favorable customer response and an increase in the average order size across all of its catalog divisions.
The company also said it has had lower catalog, operating and interest expenses than anticipated.
Brylane made an inital public offering of its stock in February.
